title: fix(lang): treat an empty language selection as automatic
body: ## Summary Passing `languages=[]` to language detection or metadata application raises `IndexError` at `languages[0]`, before either empty-text handling or automatic detection can run. An empty selection is already treated as a default by `check_language_args` and by the later automatic-detection branch. Normalize an empty language list to the existing automatic mode, just like `None`. This also uses the normal short-ASCII fallback. Explicit languages, the empty-string skip sentinel, and validation of non-list inputs retain their existing behavior. ## Validation - Added 18 native cases: 11 fail and 7 pass on the unchanged base. - New and existing language tests: **83 passed, 4 skipped**. The skips are optional backend tests in the existing suite. - Covers actual langdetect output for English/French/Korean, empty/whitespace text, short-text fallback, list/iterator metadata application in whole-document and per-element modes, unchanged input lists, and existing explicit/invalid language options. - Ruff 0.15.10 check/format and `git diff --check` pass. The full project test suite was not run. ## Checklist - [x] Added regression tests and documented empty-list behavior. - [x] Preserved explicit language selection and invalid-input checks. - [ ] Apply the `bug` label.
